// diagnostic

E0440

`{name}<>` has an empty type-argument list

What

`{name}<>` has an empty type-argument list

Why

A type's arguments go between `<` and `>`; `<>` lists none, so it only adds noise

Fix

Write the type arguments, such as `{name}<Int>`, or drop the `<>`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0440: tests/ui/empty_type_argument_list.stderr.
